Cost = TokenTracker model price x token count; tokens are measured. In multi-step turns TRAE splits cached input only for the final step, so the cache share of earlier steps is inferred from that final request's hit rate — the figure is a list-price calculation, not a billed amount.

Since Trae's 2026-09 client update the local request log no longer records cache-read fields, so the cache share cannot be read locally. The hit rate is estimated from this tool's own measured hit rate for the same model (its fielded history, 95-97% locally; models the owner never used fold with the official per-model cache-read price ratio and the tool's median measured rate); token totals stay measured and the cost is folded with that estimate.

Trae's client stopped writing cache-read fields, and this period has no usable measured evidence (neither the tool's fielded history nor official-rate evidence) — the cache share stays at the measured value (no estimate was fabricated).
